item.text: {"piece_id":"02","ready":false,"issues":["02-c5 uses an automatic-transcript numerical claim that policy treats as unverified without checking the audio.","02-c5’s locators do not support the stated “five” models or “84” tasks; they need the segments containing those figures.","The argument adds “solid validity” without evidence in the cited claims or NVIDIA walkthrough.","“The strongest current evidence” overstates a comparison the supplied evidence does not make."]}
